posts.title: Join me on Substack! Sustainably Happy
posts.description: I decided to start a new publication on Substack – it’s called Sustainably Happy. It will specifically look at the connection between ethical consumption and our mental and physical health. Please consider subscribing to it!

posts.title: Could shelf-stable Indian meals save the world?
posts.description: Indian meals can be found all over, from Whole Foods and Traders Joe’s to the Grocery Outlet. They offer one of the most convenient ways to consume legumes and are especially useful for work lunches and camping trips. Products that bring affordable and craveable legumes to a larger population deserve credit for helping save the planet.

posts.title: The Ethical Guide to… phones. Fairphone or refurbished?
posts.description: When my trusty Moto G gave up the ghost last month, I deliberated between the two most ethical options: a Fairphone and a refurbished phone. Factoring in my budget, I decided to go with the latter (which cost $100). Here’s a summary of my experience…
